Practical Tips for Choosing the Right Safety Net

Selecting the right safety net is crucial for ensuring its effectiveness and longevity. Here are some practical tips to consider:

  • Identify Your Needs: Determine the specific purpose of the safety net (e.g., pigeon control, child safety).
  • Choose the Right Material: Opt for high-quality HDPE materials that are UV stabilized for durability and weather resistance. GCM Netting Solutions exclusively uses premium HDPE.
  • Consider Mesh Size: Select the appropriate mesh size based on the target species or safety requirements. Smaller mesh sizes are ideal for preventing smaller birds or objects from passing through.
  • Professional Installation: Always choose a professional installation service to ensure the net is properly installed and secured. GCM Netting Solutions offers expert installation services.
  • Warranty: Look for a warranty that covers material defects and installation issues. GCM Netting Solutions provides a 3-5 year warranty for added peace of mind.
